answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 3870 Country: India Title: I have heard that astrophysics cant be studied. What is your view about it? Question: I have heard that astrophysics cant be studied. What is your view about it? Answer ID: 3870 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 84/84=M) What you have heard is not right; one can study the astrophysics, there is nothing wrong as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
